rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH ensembl_to_symbol AS (
SELECT
  x.ensembl_gene_id,
  -- prefer the most common/canonical gene_symbol per species in xref_gene_ensembl
  -- lift literal: tie-breaker ordering by gene_symbol ascending
  (   SELECT gene_symbol
      FROM xref_gene_ensembl x2
      WHERE x2.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
      ORDER BY gene_symbol NULLS LAST
      LIMIT 1
  ) AS gene_symbol
FROM (
  -- distinct ensembl_gene_id values present in xref_gene_ensembl
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id
  FROM xref_gene_ensembl
  WHERE ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL
) x
),
healthy_expression_by_uberon AS (
SELECT
  he.ensembl_gene_id,
  he.uberon_anatomical_id,
  he.expression_level_gene_relative,
  he.expression_score,
  he.expression_rank_score
FROM healthy_expression he
WHERE he.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL
  AND he.uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL
  -- liftable literal: minimum required quality for inclusion
  AND (he.call_quality IS NULL OR he.call_quality IN ('present','high','good'))
),
differential_expression_labeled AS (
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol,
  de.doid,
  de.log2fc,
  de.adjpvalue,
  de.expression_change_direction
FROM
  differential_expression de
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  gene_symbol,
  'differential_expression' AS source_table,
  log2fc::text AS evidence_metric
FROM differential_expression_labeled del
JOIN disease d ON del.doid = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'lung cancer'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
  e2s.gene_symbol,
  'healthy_expression' AS source_table,
  heb.expression_level_gene_relative AS evidence_metric
FROM cancer_tissue ct
JOIN healthy_expression_by_uberon heb ON heb.uberon_anatomical_id = ct.uberon_anatomical_id
JOIN ensembl_to_symbol e2s ON e2s.ensembl_gene_id = heb.ensembl_gene_id
JOIN disease d ON ct.doid = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'lung cancer'
ORDER BY gene_symbol

rows.question: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_row AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description,
    b.test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
),
-- find biomarkers with explicit disease linkage via FDA test doid or EDRN (if EDRN had disease linkage it isn't present in schema),
-- plus fallback textual matches against disease.name
biomarker_to_disease AS (
  SELECT
    b.biomarker_id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description,
    d.id AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    CASE
      WHEN bf.doid IS NOT NULL THEN 'fda_test_association'
      WHEN be.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'edrn_association'
      WHEN b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND lower(b.gene_symbol) = lower(d.name) THEN 'gene_equals_disease_name'
      WHEN b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND position(lower(d.name) IN lower(b.gene_symbol)) > 0 THEN 'gene_mentions_disease'
      WHEN b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND position(lower(d.name) IN lower(b.biomarker_description)) > 0 THEN 'description_mentions_disease'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS match_type
  FROM biomarker_row b
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda bfda ON bfda.id = b.biomarker_id
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test bf ON bf.test_trade_name = bfda.test_trade_name AND bf.test_submission = bfda.test_submission
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_edrn be ON be.id = b.biomarker_id
  LEFT JOIN disease d ON
    (
      (bf.doid IS NOT NULL AND d.id = bf.doid)
      OR (
        -- fallback textual match
        (b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND position(lower(d.name) IN lower(b.gene_symbol)) > 0)
        OR (b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND position(lower(d.name) IN lower(b.biomarker_description)) > 0)
        OR (b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND lower(b.gene_symbol) = lower(d.name))
      )
    )
  WHERE
    -- keep rows that have either an explicit FDA/EDRN link or a textual match to any disease
    bf.doid IS NOT NULL
    OR be.id IS NOT NULL
    OR (b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM disease d2 WHERE position(lower(d2.name) IN lower(b.gene_symbol)) > 0 OR lower(d2.name) = lower(b.gene_symbol)
       ))
    OR (b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM disease d3 WHERE position(lower(d3.name) IN lower(b.biomarker_description)) > 0
       ))
)
SELECT
  br.gene_symbol,
  br.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_row br
LEFT JOIN biomarker_to_disease btd ON br.biomarker_id = btd.biomarker_id
WHERE
  (
    -- prefer explicit disease name match to 'breast cancer'
    btd.disease_name ILIKE 'breast cancer'
    OR btd.disease_name ILIKE '%breast cancer%'
  )
  OR (
    -- fallback: mention of 'breast' or 'breast cancer' in biomarker fields
    br.gene_symbol ILIKE '%breast%'
    OR br.biomarker_description ILIKE '%breast%'
  )
ORDER BY br.gene_symbol ASC

rows.question: Show name of diseases where the A1BG gene expression is statistically significant
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_by_gene_and_disease AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    de.doid AS doid,
    d.id AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
    (
      de.statistical_significance IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        lower(trim(de.statistical_significance)) IN ('significant','yes','true','s','sig','statistically significant')
        OR lower(de.statistical_significance) LIKE '%significant%'
      )
    ) AS is_significant,
    de.log2fc AS log2fc,
    de.pvalue AS pvalue,
    de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue
  FROM differential_expression de
  LEFT JOIN disease d ON de.doid = d.id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  disease_name AS name
FROM differential_expression_by_gene_and_disease
WHERE gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND is_significant = true
  AND disease_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY disease_name

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_basic AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS id,
    b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
),
disease_row AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS id,
    d.name AS name
  FROM disease d
),
-- candidate links between biomarkers and diseases based on available mappings in schema
biomarker_disease_link_candidates AS (
  -- link via differential_expression -> disease (gene symbol -> ensembl mapping -> differential_expression)
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    de.doid AS disease_id
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xe
    ON b.gene_symbol = xe.gene_symbol
  JOIN differential_expression de
    ON xe.ensembl_gene_id = de.gene_symbol
  WHERE de.statistical_significance = 'significant'

  UNION

  -- link via disease_mutation -> map_protein_disease_mutation -> biomarker (ensembl transcript match)
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    dm.doid AS disease_id
  FROM disease_mutation dm
  JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mp
    ON dm.ensembl_transcript_id = mp.ensembl_transcript_id
  JOIN biomarker b
    ON mp.ensembl_transcript_id = b.biomarker_id

  UNION

  -- link via disease_mutation -> map_protein_disease_mutation -> biomarker (uniprot accession match)
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    dm.doid AS disease_id
  FROM disease_mutation dm
  JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mp
    ON dm.ensembl_transcript_id = mp.ensembl_transcript_id
  JOIN biomarker b
    ON mp.uniprotkb_ac = b.biomarker_id

  UNION

  -- link via canonical uniprot mapping
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    dm.doid AS disease_id
  FROM disease_mutation dm
  JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mp
    ON dm.ensembl_transcript_id = mp.ensembl_transcript_id
  JOIN map_uniprot_canonical_id muc
    ON mp.uniprotkb_ac = muc.uniprotkb_ac
  JOIN biomarker b
    ON muc.uniprotkb_canonical_ac = b.biomarker_id
)
SELECT
  b.gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_basic b
JOIN biomarker_disease_link_candidates l
  ON b.id = l.biomarker_id
JOIN disease_row d
  ON d.id = l.disease_id
WHERE lower(d.name) = 'breast cancer'
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol
